today.title: Today
today.rest_until: You are resting until {date}. Nothing is due, and nothing is lost.
today.rest_open: You are resting until you decide to come back. Nothing is due, and nothing is lost.
today.placement_body: A short check helps us choose the right level for you. It is not an exam. A best guess is fine.
today.noplan_title: Your plan is not ready yet
today.noplan_body: Set up how much you want to study each day, and your daily task will appear here.
today.sessions: Split into {n} shorter sessions (about {m} minutes each)
today.plan_changed: Your plan changed after you started today. The new plan applies from tomorrow.
today.empty: There are no exercises ready for you yet. Please check again later.
today.posttest_body: A short check to see how far you have come. The result is only for you.
today.stuck_body: Tell us what is getting in the way. We suggest changes, and you decide.
today.week_empty: Nothing yet. That is okay. Start whenever you are ready.

placement.title: Placement check
placement.intro: Pick the best answer. This is not an exam, and a best guess is fine.
placement.ready_body: Thank you. Let's see your starting level.
placement.empty_body: There are no placement questions available right now, so we will start you at level A1. You can change your plan at any time.
placement.few: This check had only {n} questions, so it is a rough guide.
placement.skipped: No check questions were available, so we started you at level A1.
placement.level_A1: A1 means you are building everyday words and simple sentences. We will start with the basics.
placement.level_A2: We will start you at A2: simple everyday sentences, plus a little more. This is only a starting point, and you can change your plan at any time.
placement.caution: This is a short check, not an official test. You can adjust your plan at any time.

posttest.title: 7-day self-check
posttest.intro: Pick the best answer. This is only for you.
posttest.locked_body: The self-check opens on {date}, one week after your placement check. Keep going at your own pace.
posttest.unavailable_body: There are no self-check questions available right now. Please try again later.
posttest.ready_body: Thank you. Let's see how it went.
posttest.caution: This is a short self-check, not an official result. The questions are few and different from the first check, so small changes can be luck. Use it as a gentle guide, not a grade.

task.title: Today's study
task.repeat_note: Some of today's questions are ones you have seen before. They come back for review, because our question bank is still growing.
task.seen_before: You have answered this question before. Some questions come back for review, and our question bank is still small.
task.empty_body: There are no exercises ready for you yet. Please check again later.
task.done_title: Well done. Today's study is finished.
task.done_body: Mistakes are part of learning. Rest now, or come back tomorrow.

feedback.wrong: Not this time. That is how we learn.

timer.done: Time for a short break. Stretch, drink some water, and continue when you are ready.

progress.since: The last 7 days, from {date} until today. Everything here is counted from your own answers.
progress.skills_note: A percentage appears only after 5 answers, because fewer answers say too little.
progress.tasks_none: No daily task opened in the last 7 days.
progress.tasks_note: Counted only on days when you opened the daily task ({total} in the last 7 days).
progress.stuck_title: Times you told us you were stuck
progress.plan_none: No plan changes in the last 7 days.
progress.tests_cta: Your self-check is ready. Take it
progress.tests_caution: These are short self-checks, not official results.
